notes: Valheim's dedicated server exposes no command channel: Iron Gate documents no RCON and no admin API, and the server process takes no typed commands on its own console (it is stopped with Ctrl+C / SIGINT so the world saves). The Kick PLAYERNAME / Ban PLAYERNAME / Unban PLAYERNAME / Banned commands Iron Gate lists run in a CLIENT's F5 admin console while connected to the server as an admin (some guides also say Steam clients need the -console launch option; Iron Gate does not mention it); they cannot be issued from the host, which is why no commands are recorded here. Out-of-band moderation is the three plain-text lists in the server's save directory - adminlist.txt, bannedlist.txt, permittedlist.txt - one Platform User ID per line, format '[Platform]_[User ID] (case sensitive)' per Iron Gate; note that populating permittedlist.txt locks out everyone not on it. Sources disagree on the literal platform token: WinterNode and Host Havoc both give Steam as 'V_' + SteamID64 (Xbox 'X_') and WinterNode adds that a bare SteamID64 stopped working at 1.0, Iron Gate documents only the [Platform]_[User ID] shape without naming the token, and the pre-crossplay Fandom wiki shows a bare SteamID64; no primary source confirms a literal, so no playerId.prefix is asserted and lineIdPattern instead tolerates any [Letters]_ prefix and captures the bare numeric id - a manager WRITING a ban line must re-add whatever prefix that server's own log/F2 panel shows. banList paths are relative to the SAVE directory, not the install root the schema assumes: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\IronGate\Valheim on Windows, ~/.config/unity3d/IronGate/Valheim on Linux, or whatever -savedir points at (/config in the common Docker images). Sources also disagree on live reload - Host Havoc says restart the server after editing, so assume a restart is required. XGamingServer's docs claim Valheim has 'very limited' native Source RCON answering save/info/quit; nothing from Iron Gate supports that and no independent source repeats it, so it is recorded as disputed and not acted on - that single conflict, plus the fact that 'none' is a negative claim, is why confidence is low.
